svg.title: Ze first-party codebase growth from December 2025 to November 2026
svg.desc: Daily stacked area chart of Ze's first-party Go lines from 19 December 2025 to 27 November 2026. Production Go grows from 56,000 to 2.08 million lines, Go tests overtake production in July and reach 2.50 million lines for 4.58 million first-party Go lines total, and functional tests under test/ grow to 336,000 lines.
svg.text: DAILY REPOSITORY HISTORY · 19 DEC 2025 TO 27 NOV 2026
First-party code over time: Go production, Go tests and functional tests
Daily snapshots from website/data/repo-history.json through 27 Nov 2026. Apr–Jun excludes 232,870 temporary gokrazy/tools/vendor lines.
